svg.title: Cache configuration and delivery topology
svg.desc: Topology showing a multi-region storefront connected to Azure Managed Redis, App Configuration, Key Vault, a delivery pipeline, and deployment stacks.

g.aria-label: cache-aside catalog reads: storefront to cache
feature and configuration refresh: storefront to configuration
managed-identity secret access: storefront to secrets

svg.text: Storefront instances use Managed Redis and App Configuration while secrets stay in Key Vault and deployments flow through bounded stacks.
